setup: Demonstrate all supported flow node types with the simplified plan schema.
objective: Complete implementation and validation tasks with deterministic and AI-gated loops.
persona: You are a senior software engineer. Write clean, well-tested TypeScript code.

flow.prompt: Read README.md and summarize a concrete implementation plan before changing code.
Implement one focused improvement and include a short change summary in the report.
Review the recent changes for correctness and style. Summarize findings in the report.
flow.persona: You are a meticulous code reviewer focused on correctness, edge cases, and maintainability.

steps.prompt: Inspect the repository state and summarize what changed so far.
Prepare a quick validation checklist before running tests.
Run npm test and summarize outcomes. Write the report even if tests fail.
Run npm run typecheck and summarize outcomes. Write the report even if it fails.

args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const pass=fs.existsSync('README.md'); console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:pass,score:pass?1:0,reasons:pass?['README.md exists']:['README.md missing']}));

body.prompt: Repair repository sanity issues so the deterministic gate can pass.

gate.prompt: Inspect recent workflow results and decide if the objective is complete. Return JSON only.

body.prompt: Apply the highest-impact improvement suggested by prior task outputs.
